description: For a strict total order, well-foundedness is equivalent to every nonempty subset having a least element, with the least-element comparison stated explicitly.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.wellOrdered_iff_least.{u} {M : Type u} {r : M → M → Prop} :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.WellOrdered r ↔
    IsStrictTotalOrder M r ∧ ∀ (s : Set M), s.Nonempty → ∃ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, a = b ∨ r a b
